subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: When an agent calls the `nodes` tool with `action: "describe"` and no `node`, should OpenClaw describe a default node or return discovery/list-style data?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the issue discussion and linked PR differ on the permanent no-node `describe` contract, especially for multi-node setups.

options.title: Default-node describe
options.body: Confirm default-node resolution as the intended read-only fallback, then land or replace the linked PR with regression coverage and real behavior proof.

options.title: List-style discovery
options.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as discovery output and replace the linked PR with a patch that returns node inventory instead of choosing a target.

options.title: Schema-required node
options.body: Make `node` required for `describe`, accepting that agents must use `status` or another discovery action before describing a node.

recommendation.title: Default-node describe
recommendation.body: Confirm default-node resolution as the intended read-only fallback, then land or replace the linked PR with regression coverage and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current history across the nodes tool schema, resolver, and related agent-tool refactors.
